releases.notes:
This is the release of my Minecraft mod "Simple Shared Villager Discounts" for the Minecraft versions 26.1 to 26.3.

### Installation

Put the mod-.jar into the mods folder of your minecraft instance. (By default at %appdata%/.minecraft). Make sure to download the version of the mod compatible with your minecraft version.

Dependencies:

-  [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) needs to be installed and
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) needs to be added to the mods folder.

readmeSummary: A simple server-side Minecraft Fabric mod that gives any player trading with a cured villager the curing-discount.
